# GoGo

> GoGo is a native Agent Runtime and Control Plane for long-running autonomous software work — plan, decompose, execute, recover, and deliver via observable Agent Teams. Built by CharonZou. Source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 (not OSI open source). Desktop app: EvoPanel.

## Official links

- [GitHub (public face)](https://github.com/CharonZou/GoGo): Docs, releases, issues
- [Product site](https://www.charonzou.com): Product and hosted docs entry
- [Releases](https://github.com/CharonZou/GoGo/releases): Desktop installers
- [License](https://github.com/CharonZou/GoGo/blob/main/LICENSE): Non-commercial terms
- [Security](https://github.com/CharonZou/GoGo/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Private vulnerability reporting
